title: Ten cyclic cube fields with ranked proper-run bounds

claims.statement: The explicit ten-field cyclic cube encoder with Golay and Hamming parity and its radius-23, depth-dependent cost list decoder for 1000 message bits on 2000 BSC(1/10) uses have average block error at most 31924188747210713/200000000000000000.
The same bsc-ops-v1 decoder executes at most W=70484566301335116987477129842234353111923230085460388110258 primitives on every received word, with W<=2^(19549/100).

experiments.purpose: Check the exact full-direction occupancy bound and the sector of proper-run lengths. Part zero also checks the exact miss bound, field and worst-case operation inequality.
